subject: Social Media
title: Digital Rights Movements
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Digital Rights Movements.

hook.text: The EFF, Access Now, and digital rights groups fight for online freedoms the way the ACLU fights for offline ones.

buildup.text: Digital rights include privacy, free expression, encryption, and net neutrality. All contested by governments and firms.

discovery.text: The EU's GDPR gave users the right to delete data. It became a global model—companies changed policies worldwide.

twist.text: But rights on paper mean little without enforcement. Most people click 'accept all cookies' without reading anything.

climax.text: Digital rights are human rights for the online age. The struggle is the same: power vs. freedom, scaled up.

punchline.text: Every generation fights for rights. This one's digital.

quiz.question: What major impact did the EU's GDPR have globally?
options: It banned social media in Europe
It had no effect outside Europe
